rows.notes: Futagami asks which intelligence card to share first; explicit we/question verb.

rows.en: The script for this play... There was originally only one...
rows.notes: Kaji explaining to Futagami; one original script, sentence trails off.

rows.en: Right. It's based on myths from ancient times. Though nobody knows who wrote it anymore.
rows.notes: Futagami replies; ancient myths, author now unknown, not a named creator.

rows.en: There's a theory that the creators of the Martian ruins wrote it... But we have neither the means nor the time to prove it.
rows.notes: Kaji supplies hypothesis about Martian ruins creators, no proof means or time.

rows.en: Well, I suppose they're something like gods to us...
rows.notes: Futagami qualifies writers as godlike to us; gender-neutral plural they.

rows.en: The problem is, some people decided to stage the outrageous script they left behind.
rows.notes: Futagami identifies would-be directors of outrageous inherited script; agency restored.

rows.en: Yes... To make the theater function as a theater...
rows.notes: Kaji explains purpose, keeping theater function and deliberate purpose-clause trail.

rows.en: But a play means nothing without an audience.
rows.notes: Kaji contrasts need for an audience; all source meaning retained.

rows.en: And so a grand production began to draw in that audience.
rows.notes: Futagami continues causal theater metaphor; actors not identified prematurely.

rows.en: Unfortunately... Several theater companies raised the curtain, each with a different take on the play.
rows.notes: Futagami describes multiple companies and distinct staging; theater companies not actual corporations.

rows.en: What's more... They did it at the same time, in the same theater.
rows.notes: Futagami underscores same time and same theater; subject they recovered from171.

rows.en: Naturally, the play became a complete mess. So they hurriedly brought in two dei ex machina.
rows.notes: Futagami identifies exactly two rescuing gods; conventional Latin plural dei ex machina.

rows.en: Deus ex machina... A god from a machine, appearing in ancient Greek drama...
rows.notes: Kaji echoes Latin term then ancient Greek dramatic machine-god definition; fragment intentionally kept.

rows.en: And a being who brings down the curtain on a play that's spiraled out of control.
rows.notes: Kaji continues174 definition; being resolving uncontrollable drama, not an added machine identity.

rows.en: But the price of rushing to resolve it was steep.
rows.notes: Futagami warns of price of haste; full predicate and actors generic.

rows.en: One of those mechanical gods, instead of bringing the play to an end...
rows.notes: Futagami begins one god's deviation; unfinished row continues178.

rows.en: Left the theater itself, taking the head of one of the theater companies along.
rows.notes: Futagami completes177; one company head and god leave theater itself.

rows.en: And the actors left behind had nowhere to turn... So they shut themselves away in a greenroom called the Chamber of Guf.
rows.notes: Futagami describes remaining actors retreat; greenroom function and Chamber of Guf both retained.
uncertain: Chamber of Guf follows provisional campaign term; exact licensed MX wording unverified.

rows.en: That left the theater's owners in trouble... They tried to bring those actors out.
rows.notes: Kaji identifies theater owners trying to get actors out; no reversed direction.

rows.en: Yeah. But those actors got desperate and went on a rampage...
rows.notes: Futagami refers to actors from179180; rampage and desperation retained.

rows.en: The bastards even claimed ownership of the theater.
rows.notes: Futagami emphatic contempt for actors claiming ownership; bastards maintains angry wording.

rows.en: And with no options left, the theater's owners had no choice but to seal off the theater itself.
rows.notes: Kaji owners compelled to seal entire theater, not merely a room.

rows.en: Using the power of a new deus ex machina, created with wisdom borrowed from a god...
rows.notes: Kaji continues183 with means, wisdom borrowed from god creates new deus; clause left unfinished.

rows.en: And the account of how it all happened... That's the "Secret Dead Sea Scrolls," then.
rows.notes: Futagami names qualified Secret Dead Sea Scrolls, not unqualified historical document.

rows.en: Yes. But... There are multiple copies.
rows.notes: Kaji answers with multiple copies; no invented exact number.

rows.en: Yeah... At least one in this world, and one in the Mu world...
rows.notes: Futagami supplies at least one per world, preserving lower bound.

rows.en: So Bahbem, the Mulians... And SEELE all know how the others direct their plays.
rows.notes: Futagami names three knowing each other's staging; no implication of agreement.

rows.en: In other words... As it happened, the last play was "performed in two worlds at the same time."
rows.notes: Futagami specifies simultaneous performance in TWO worlds, preserving quoted description.

rows.en: That's why... A deus ex machina, supposedly gone without a trace ages ago, appeared in this world.
rows.notes: Kaji causal reappearance of apparently completely vanished ancient god; no absent unit substitution.

rows.en: That's right. Bahbem's black egg was sent here from the Mu world...
rows.notes: Futagami black egg transported FROM Mu world; no invented sender.

rows.en: So the Mulians, who are losing their own theater, set their sights on our world.
rows.notes: Futagami Mulians losing own theater turn toward OUR world; temporal losing retained.

rows.en: And once again... Three theater companies began a grand production over who owns the theater.
rows.notes: Futagami THREE companies restart ownership struggle in theater metaphor.

rows.en: Those three are SEELE, Mu and the Bahbem Foundation...
rows.notes: Futagami enumerates SEELE Mu Foundation, no fourth prematurely.

rows.en: No, there are four.
rows.notes: Kaji corrects count to FOUR; no added name until196.

rows.en: Oh, right. I forgot about Gendo Ikari's NERV.
rows.notes: Futagami realizes fourth is Gendo Ikari's NERV; forgot subject restored.

rows.en: ...But this time, the play's script was incomplete.
rows.notes: Kaji reports incomplete script THIS time, not original complete certainty.

rows.en: It's ancient, and apocryphal at that. It's no wonder the Secret Dead Sea Scrolls left in this world have so many parts missing.
rows.notes: Futagami ancient apocryphal text, many missing parts unavoidable; Secret qualifier retained.

rows.en: And on top of that, some people make up their own interpretations, while others ad-lib. What a headache.
rows.notes: Futagami complains about arbitrary interpretation and ad-lib; no invented author.

rows.en: So the play's an even bigger mess than last time... Some scenes were skipped, and some actors never even got to appear.
rows.notes: Futagami increases chaos vs prior play, both skipped scenes and actors never appearing retained.

rows.en: Those are the Angels with "missing numbers"...
rows.notes: Kaji identifies missing-number Angels, not unnamed Angels generally; quoted missing numbers retained.

rows.en: And... Once again, they brought in dei ex machina to bring the play back under control.
rows.notes: Futagami explains renewed deus intervention; plurality justified by203.

rows.en: Those are EVA-01 and Raideen... And #部隊名.
rows.notes: Futagami explicitly names EVA-01 Raideen runtime squad; no RahXephon substitution.

rows.en: ...It seems we see things the same way.
rows.notes: Kaji notes shared understanding with Futagami; subject we explicit.

rows.en: Yeah, we do.
rows.notes: Futagami confirms; subject/predicate restored rather than bare fragment.

rows.en: And what SEELE, Bahbem and Mu are really after is...
rows.notes: Kaji begins goal clause, deliberately left to207.

rows.en: To rebuild the theater as its final curtain approaches, and move on to the next stage...
rows.notes: Futagami completes206 purpose rebuild theater and advance stage; no deity identity inserted.

rows.en: In other words, the "Multiverse Instrumentality Project." That's the original script.
rows.notes: Futagami names Multiverse Instrumentality Project as ORIGINAL script; exact campaign term.
uncertain: Multiverse Instrumentality Project follows provisional campaign term; exact licensed MX title unverified.

rows.en: But there are two ways to carry it out. "Instrumentality" and "tuning"...
rows.notes: Kaji TWO alternative means Instrumentality/tuning, quoted source labels retained.

rows.en: Which of those gets chosen depends on the deus ex machina...
rows.notes: Futagami choice depends on deus ex machina; no assertion which will win.

rows.en: Though the spotlight called the Star of Ra Mu hasn't been switched on yet.
rows.notes: Futagami says Star of Ra Mu spotlight not yet applied; specific recipient is unstated. Removed draft them so English does not invent a target; no fit compression.

rows.en: So... You're looking for a third way, aren't you?
rows.notes: Futagami asks Kaji whether he seeks THIRD method, remains question.

rows.en: I'll leave that to your imagination.
rows.notes: Kaji evasive reply does not confirm third plan.

rows.en: Is that so? Then I'll share a little information I've been saving.
rows.notes: Futagami offers special information to Kaji; no reversed request direction.

rows.en: What is it?
rows.notes: Kaji asks what information, explicit English verb.

rows.en: The Far East Command's First Division was just ordered to sortie.
rows.notes: Futagami relays just-issued sortie order to FIRST division of Far East Command.
uncertain: Far East Command is established source-literal campaign label; independent licensed MX English designation unestablished.

rows.notes: Kaji surprise punctuation-only reaction retained.

rows.en: Apparently, the newly appointed Far East commander will lead it personally. And they're heading for Hakone.
rows.notes: Futagami qualified report new commander personally commanding, destination Hakone.
uncertain: Far East Command is established source-literal campaign label; independent licensed MX English designation unestablished.

rows.en: As I thought, the final enemy is...
rows.notes: Kaji thinks enemy conclusion but intentionally unfinished; not named Miwa here.

rows.en: #部隊名 returns to Earth tomorrow, right? ...You'd better hurry.
rows.notes: Futagami asks tomorrow squad Earth return then urges Kaji haste; runtime preserved.

rows.en: Then I'll give you some information in return. He'll probably choose Mutropolis as his seat in the audience.
rows.notes: Kaji reciprocal intel; he refers to Bahbem, probability preserved, Mutropolis spectator-seat metaphor.

rows.en: I see. Then I suppose I'll drop by later.
rows.notes: Futagami chooses visit later, no threat or confirmed departure.

rows.en: Well, I'll be going, then.
rows.notes: Kaji taking leave, I and verb restored.

rows.en: ...Whatever you do, don't get ahead of yourself.
rows.notes: Futagami cautions Kaji against premature action, not movement command.

rows.en: Sure, we're backstage hands. But we still have a job to do: see how the play ends.
rows.notes: Futagami states shared backstage role and duty to see conclusion.

rows.en: Besides... Surely even hunting dogs can kill their own prey once in a while?
rows.notes: Futagami intelligence-agent hunting-dog metaphor retains killing own prey, rhetorical permission.

rows.en: Yes... Both of us.
rows.notes: Kaji agrees both agents can pursue prey; deliberately elliptical affirmative.

rows.en: The appointed time has come.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE participant speaking to Gendo, label unknown remains ???.

rows.en: Mu will act soon... Its effects will reach Lilith, too.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE predicts Mu movement affecting Lilith; no imported impact mechanism.

rows.en: Bahbem has foreseen that as well. Hence, we cannot achieve Instrumentality through Lilith.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE Bahbem foresaw consequence; inability via Lilith retained.

rows.en: Our sole hope is for EVA-01, Lilith's other self, to carry it out.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE hopes for sole EVA-01 route and Lilith-other-self link, not certainty.

rows.en: Though that differs from SEELE's script...
rows.notes: Gendo qualifies divergence from SEELE script; sentence trails off deliberately.

rows.en: Of course, our true goal is the Multiverse Instrumentality Project.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE restates true Multiverse Instrumentality Project goal.
uncertain: Multiverse Instrumentality Project follows provisional campaign term; exact licensed MX title unverified.

rows.en: Humans existed in order to create the EVAs.
rows.notes: Fuyutsuki claims humanity exists to produce EVA; no softening or added time claim.

rows.en: Humanity must advance into a new world. That is what the EVA series is for.
rows.notes: Gendo argues humanity should move to new world via EVA series; normative force retained.

rows.en: We will not abandon our human forms to board an ark named EVA.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE rejects abandonment of human form to board EVA ark, not rejection of every EVA use.

rows.en: This is a rite of passage, so that humanity, at an impasse, may be reborn.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE rite permits stalled humanity's rebirth; subordinate purpose retained.

rows.en: The destiny of extinction is also the joy of new birth.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE extinction fate also new-birth joy, strength unsoftened.

rows.en: So that gods and humans... all life will eventually become one through death.
rows.notes: Unidentified SEELE continues purpose of death followed by oneness of gods humans ALL LIFE; not just souls.

rows.en: To survive the collapse of all worlds and continue to exist.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker continues preceding purpose clause about all life becoming one; infinitive fragment retained across row boundary; ALL worlds and continued existence explicit.

rows.en: Death creates nothing.
rows.notes: Gendo challenges the death-based proposal; no softening.

rows.en: Then we shall give death to you both.
rows.notes: Hidden interlocutor threatens Gendo and Fuyutsuki together; plural you retained by scene and notes.

rows.en: People exist through their will to go on living. That is what she wished for when she chose to remain in EVA.
rows.notes: Fuyutsuki defends will to live; she is the woman who voluntarily remained in EVA, full-stage later Yui context; pronoun kept without expanding her identity.

rows.en: Yes... At last, it begins.
rows.notes: Gendo announces the beginning, not completion.

Mark my words! I shall return!

I'm counting on you to carry on!

They got me?! No way!!

Take care of my mom for me...!!

Tch, that's all for today!
